[Story]
Anna donates a precious antique at a charity event organized by the company. She puts the antique in a special display area. Carl, a new employee, does not understand the value and importance of this antique, mistakes it for discarded items, and throws it into the trash can during cleaning. At the same time, Bo sees this scene, but because he is Anna's competitor and hopes to surpass Anna at the party, he deliberately does not tell Carl the truth. When Anna finds out that the antique is missing, she feels extremely shocked and disappointed, and starts looking around. Later, Carl realizes the mistake he may have made after hearing colleagues discuss the value of the antique.

[Question]
What is the possible intention behind Carl's behavior?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Carl may not pay attention to its value because he is not interested in antiques.
B. Carl may think that cleaning the display area is more important than keeping the items.
C. Carl may be due to ignorance or misunderstanding, because he mistakenly thinks that the antique is a useless discarded item.
D. Carl may overlook the importance of the item because he wants to complete the task quickly.
